This is the all-new Renault Twingo!

It’s set to go on general sale in the UK by the end of 2026, and with a targeted price tag of under £20,000, it might be the must-have affordable car of the year!

The question is: with such a low price tag, is it more style over substance? Let’s take a closer look…

In terms of the exterior design, the new Twingo has so much character! It remains faithful to the original’s design while still looking modern. The eye-styled DRLs further add to the cute design, and the car still looks great in this bright yellow colour. Along the side you’ll find windows without seals, and at the back the taillights are shaped similarly to those at the front, again further adding to the car’s character.
